description: Read current published Dedicated Internet bandwidth prices, installation fees, initial term, billing and service terms. The result distinguishes the connected-building online installation offer from standard Nearby installation fees by bandwidth. Check the building before preparing an order. Before placing an order, show the actual customer the exact building, bandwidth, monthly price, installation fee, survey requirement where applicable, term and linked service terms. Nearby orders use the standard installation fee for the selected bandwidth from the published Dedicated Internet schedule. Explain that feasibility, installation scope and timing require a site survey; special construction or changes to the displayed price or terms require separate approval before work begins. Never promise the connected-building online installation offer or timing for a Nearby order. Obtain that customer’s explicit acceptance and confirmation that they are authorized to order for the company. Never infer consent or authority from an availability or pricing inquiry.
name: get_pricing
title: Get current Dedicated Internet pricing
